title: JioStar takes Indian entertainment, films, news to US viewers through Fubo
description:
JioStar on Thursday announced that it has launched seven of its television channels on US-based live TV streaming platform Fubo, expanding the availability of its Indian entertainment, movie and news content to audiences in the United States.
The channels, which went live on November 16, include Star Plus, Colors, Star Bharat, Colors Rishtey, Colors Cineplex, MTV India and News18 English, catering to South Asian households across the country.
The line-up brings a mix of fiction and non-fiction programming, Hindi films, youth-oriented entertainment and news content to Fubo subscribers, offering viewers access to some of India's popular television shows and entertainment franchises.
Star Plus, Colors, Star Bharat and Colors Rishtey will feature a range of general entertainment programming, including popular shows such as "Anupama", "Yeh Rishta Kya Kehlata Hai" and "Kyunki Saas Bhi Kabhi Bahu Thi", along with reality programmes and franchises such as "Bigg Boss", "India Ke Top 1 Percen
